thread:
sam_release: FYI rc-2 ready for release window at 21:00 UTC. deploy-bot shows all checks green except SBOM signer for eu-west-1 is still pending. vuln-scan: PASS.

deploy-bot: [rc-2] starting final gating checks... SBOM_SIGNER_STATUS=queued (eu-west-1)

alice_sre: Ugh. EU signer lag again? that was flaky last week.

rahul_sec: Can we ship without the cosign signature if vuln scan is clean? what's the legal/approval bar here? :thinking:

liz_legal: We need signature for regional compliance if the image will be published to a customer-facing registry in EU. If it's internal-only or behind a feature flag we might be able to carve out an exception, but need security sign-off.

miguel_qa: QA has a canary running in us-west-2 already. No regressions. We can stagger rollout to push to global except eu until signature clears.

jen_ops: ops note: if we carve out EU we should pin the runtime base image digest and prevent auto-promote. Otherwise an unverified image could slip. command to pin: `kubectl set image deployment/api api=registry/...@sha256:<digest>`

sam_release: Proposal: 1) Push rc-2 to non-EU (us-west/us-east) at 21:00. 2) Hold eu-west-1 until cosign SBOM signature arrives or for 6h timeout. 3) Publish release notes with an EU carveout line. 4) Pin base image in EU manifests for the hold. Thoughts?

rahul_sec: +1 for staggered. Also request: add a short audit note with evidence of vuln-scan (sha256 + scan report link) so we can close the temporary exception if legal ok.

liz_legal: I can sign an exception if security posts the evidence and we set a hard timeout. We prefer avoid exceptions but okay with timeboxed carveout. What timeout are we setting?

sam_release: Suggest 6 hours. If signature not present by 03:00 UTC, we rollback EU publish and escalate to security/infra to manually sign or re-run pipeline.

miguel_qa: QA will run an extra regression in staged EU cluster once signer appears. ETA for extra run ~15m.

deploy-bot: [rc-2] deploy plan created. Targets: us-west-2, us-east-1. eu-west-1 => HOLD (pending SBOM signature). Can rollback via `/deploy cancel rc-2 eu-west-1` or `/deploy promote rc-2 eu-west-1` when ready.

alice_sre: Small ops ask — add a route rule so traffic to eu endpoints route to fallback infra if EU not promoted. We should avoid partial failure modes.

jen_ops: noted. I'll add the temporary route. Also setting manifest to pinned digest for eu manifests now.

rahul_sec: I'll attach the vuln-scan snapshot here when done: https://internal-scans/runs/2039 (will post hash in a sec)

rahul_sec: scan hash: `sha256:4b8c...e2a9`. Evidence linked.

liz_legal: Received evidence. I approve a 6h carveout for EU conditioned on: pinned digest, audit note, QA regression on promote, and explicit manual promote.

sam_release: OK. Action items: jen_ops pins EU manifests + add route rule (jen_ops), rahul posts scan evidence (rahul_sec done), miguel runs extra QA on promote (miguel_qa), liz_legal approves timeboxed carveout (liz_legal). We'll proceed with non-EU push now.

deploy-bot: [rc-2] deploying to us-west-2... success. us-east-1... success. eu-west-1 marked HOLD (reason: SBOM signer timeout).

alice_sre: Rolling metrics look good so far. Latency stable. :thumbsup:

sam_release: Publishing release notes now with EU carveout note: 
- rc-2: staged global rollout. EU publish delayed pending SBOM cosign signature. Will update thread when promoted.

jen_ops: Route rule in place, EU manifests pinned to `sha256:4b8c...e2a9`.

mikhael_ops: (automation) reminder: automated signer retry kicked at 21:12 UTC.

rahul_sec: signer came back online, cosign attached: `cosign:signature-2026-03-21T21:18Z`.

deploy-bot: [rc-2] eu-west-1: SBOM signature verified. Ready to promote when manual trigger received.

miguel_qa: I'll run the regression now. ETA 12m.

miguel_qa: regression green.

sam_release: Promoting EU now via `/deploy promote rc-2 eu-west-1` — monitoring.

deploy-bot: [rc-2] eu-west-1: promotion success. release complete.

liz_legal: Thanks team — closing carveout. Please keep the audit note attached to the release for 90 days.

sam_release: Noting final timeline and artifacts in release ticket. Good run. :tada:
